title: The Goodness of God
definition: The goodness of God means that God is morally perfect, generous, kind, and good in all He is and does.
summary: God's goodness is seen in creation, providence, salvation, discipline, mercy, and every good gift.
christFocus: Jesus demonstrated God's goodness through compassion, healing, teaching, sacrifice, and resurrection hope.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: God's goodness is seen in creation, providence, salvation, discipline, mercy, and every good gift.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, trust Him more deeply, and follow Christ with clarity instead of confusion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
